research-record.title: Wyrd full-tracker triage: inheritance audit for the reboot

banner.note: Status: completed audit (gandr-6j4, owner-directed 2026-07-21, run before F3 dispatch). Every one of the 365 wyrd-tracker beads is classified below as (a) already realized/tracked in the reboot, (b) INHERIT (gandr bead minted), (c) retired-with-reason, or (d) owner-decision-needed.

Method: full-content read of every non-closed bead plus every decision and epic (all states); title-and-close-reason triage for the remaining closed implementation beads, with full reads wherever classification was uncertain. Claims of realization were verified against the reboot tree (ported crates, PLAN.html, gandr beads, workflow docs), not inferred from titles.

Citation scope: wyrd bead ids appear in this record strictly as reconciliation keys (tracker cross-references), never as citable authorities; no wyrd ADR numbers are cited. Forward-looking content is restated in current terms, per the 2026-07-21 citation rule and the PLAN H7 tracker-provenance policy. The wyrd side was read-only throughout.

Mid-triage concurrency event: a sibling session landed the run half of the motivating binder rename as commit ddb86c2 (syntax-only) and closed gandr-55v with residuals on gandr-6re. The Dolt push raced; the conflict was resolved for the remote per the sync rule, and the remaining decision content was re-minted as gandr-07e and gandr-wu4.

section.title: Summary
section.prose: The wyrd tracker held 365 beads (274 closed, 60 open, 22 deferred, 9 in-progress). Disposition: 242 realized , 97 retired , 21 inherit , 5 owner . The 21 inherit rows collapse into twelve minted gandr beads (eleven new plus the gandr-55v expansion, which the mid-triage landing converted into gandr-07e); the five owner rows are queued in the decisions section. The dominant pattern: closed wyrd implementation work either rode the verbatim ports (substrate burst, F0–F2, B1) or is named in the reboot backbone and lanes (PLAN §4, §7.1); the dangerous category was exactly the motivating instance — ratified-but-unimplemented decision state living only in the tracker.

section.title: The motivating instance, resolved
section.prose: The charter's motivating case was the binder-rebinding decision: ratified in the wyrd tracker (epic wyrd-s0yz , decision wyrd-gi1a , lanes wyrd-dbdk / wyrd-j3nl ) but invisible to the port pipeline, which read the wyrd git tree and framed wyrd beads as IDs to scrub. The audit confirmed the mechanism and found it had a second layer: the only pre-existing reboot record (gandr-55v) carried an owner-recalled fragment of the decision — the run half only — with its origin recorded as unknown. The full decision is: (1) binder lane — val p = v; renames the value bind and binding-only run p <- c; renames the computation-result bind, retiring let (a statement opens with a binding keyword iff it introduces a name, and the keyword names the category bound; bare sequencing, blocks, and tails are unchanged; no do-notation family); (2) annotation lane — an optional -> T answer-type slot on check-only eliminators (the constant motive, degenerate case of the motive slot) plus binder-side run p : F T <- c .

section.title: Queued for owner decision
section.prose: Five forks the reboot plan does not answer, in compact form. Each is a decision request, not scheduled work.

list.item: Whether the calf step^c cost layer graduates to a gandr effect layer ( wyrd-arnn ; the transport-costing speculation wyrd-szsr rides it). No reboot home exists: the tail names effects and erasure passes but no cost layer. Adopt (name a phase), defer to a named tail pass, or drop.

The codata/coinduction productivity ladder (sized types per Abel–Pientka, corecursion sugar, ν-decoder, coinductive relations) and the grade-informed region/escape promotion refinement (perf-stop-gated; the shrink debug-invariant materializes with it) — residue of wyrd-5qdq.1 . The codata MVP is built and ported, but the ladder has no named phase. Name one, or mark re-askable.

item.lead: D3 — CMTT vs nominal, and the metaprogramming home

list.item: wyrd-u00z deferred the CMTT-subsumption decision until the nominal layer existed; it now does (theory-nominal-automata, adopted). Metaprogramming is adopted-unbuilt with no backbone phase. Name the phase that takes the decision (B6-elaborator era?), or confirm re-askable.

wyrd-m0ov : evaluate a compile-checked #[contract] attribute that parses the existing rustdoc at the item. The rustdoc convention itself is fully realized (rust.md + the adequacy gates' machine extraction), so this is tooling polish — adopt, or decline and keep rustdoc-only.
wyrd-p6dk : the four-face closeout rule is guidance-only in both trackers. Adopt a mechanical check (bead-metadata or checklist gate), or keep guidance-only explicitly.

The wyrd-era scheduled campaigns never ran over much of the code that later ported, and the reboot's campaign clock is parked until go-public (ci.md). When the clock returns, the first campaign should be a fresh whole-workspace baseline over the ported crates — the wyrd baseline does not transfer. Rides the owner's out-of-band go-public call.

item.lead: Wyrd ADR citations in ported crate comments

list.item: Ported crates still carry extensive wyrd ADR-number citations in rustdoc (100+ files; e.g. theory-virtual-doctrines module headers). This is the known H7 residue: the tracker-provenance policy rewrites as touched, F0 set the drop-with-distilled-provenance precedent, and gandr-mf8 tracks the doc-comment citation re-pointing. No new bead filed.

Decisions touching the in-flight ladder were given special attention per the charter. Findings: the binder-rename family sequences after F4 by design (gandr-07e, gandr-wu4); the computation-sort Unknown spelling touches the F3 lowering hub (gandr-89k); the rule 2-cell lowering is the F3-era gateway to the computads layer and B11 (gandr-0rb); B3's module design (b3-module-system-design.md) already inventories every M1-lite bead and the package-import question, so nothing module-side needed minting; B4's predesign records the erasure-shape fork that two wyrd research threads fed into.
